name: ParkSim-VLA-Bench-v0
description: Reproducible high-level policy benchmark for ParkSim Qwen-VLA and deterministic baselines.
notes: All agents share the same lower-level A*/Stanley/parking executor unless the agent is the original rule_based controller.
Qwen-VLA must choose an action_id from valid_actions; safety shield rejects malformed or unsafe choices.
Preference pairs are derived from completed/path/time/shield/fallback objective scores and are intended for prompt optimization or offline preference tuning.
Benchmark validation fails on empty or structurally incomplete episode logs so paper tables do not include partial runs.
Safety metrics are computed from synchronized ego/background traces and decision logs, including near-miss, collision-proxy, TTC, and unsafe occupancy choices.
Visualizer video artifacts should be paired with video_manifest.json to bind videos, frame counts, simulation-time alignment, and metrics.
